secrets.name: IG_SESSION_ID
secrets.description: Optional Instagram sessionid cookie from an account you control that is the profile owner or an approved follower. Use the secure Secrets input, never chat. Instagram permissions and rate limits still apply.

secrets.name: GMAIL_USER
secrets.description: Gmail address to send invoice emails from (e.g. chiragkashyap201@gmail.com). Enable 2FA and create an App Password at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords

secrets.name: GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Gmail App Password (16-char code from myaccount.google.com/apppasswords) for the sending account

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key for GPT-4o Vision to verify UPI payment screenshots. Get it from platform.openai.com/api-keys. Without this, all submissions default to manual admin review.
